title: Validation action
statement: For an $m$-work-tape machine, a work-tape index $r$, states $v_0,v_1,v_S$, a parity bit $e$, and an optional Boolean $a$, define an action as follows. If $a$ is true, move the input head one position to the right, leave all work-tape heads stationary without writing, emit no output, and enter $v_0$ when $e$ is true or $v_1$ when $e$ is false. If $a$ is false and $e$ is true, leave both the input and work-tape heads stationary, make no writes, emit false, and halt; if $a$ is false and $e$ is false, move the input head one position to the right, leave all work-tape heads stationary without writing, emit no output, and enter $v_S$. If $a$ is absent, leave both the input and work-tape heads stationary, make no writes, emit false, and halt.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number $m$ of work tapes
